metadata.age_definition: Days since first observed advert, not verified continuous time on market or unit sale duration
metadata.completeness: Source count gate is a heuristic; full portal coverage is not certified
metadata.official_context_status: Not integrated; consult source releases with their own reference dates
metadata.price_basis: Advert asking PSF; unadjusted for composition; matched rates use exact seven-day observed pairs
